sources.title: Wulver v0.1 Released: Anime-Focused Fine-Tune… · AGI Hunt
sources.snippet: A developer released Wulver v0.1, a full fine-tune of Krea 2 Raw (12.8B) specifically designed for anime, kemono, and furry art styles. The model features native handling of multiple interacting characters without fusing them, fast generation (8-14 steps), and offers fp8, int8, and GGUF quantized versions.
